title: Daisy-chained nodes around a column
description: A 300x100x50mm enclosure has a structural column keep-out at x 140-160, y 30-70, full height. Place psu (50x40x30mm), node_a (30x30x20mm) and node_b (30x30x20mm). Power is daisy-chained: wire 1 runs psu -> node_a (psu_out -> a_in), wire 2 runs node_a -> node_b (a_in -> b_in). Required exactly: 'V1 psu_out 0 DC 12', 'Ra a_in 0 30', 'Rb b_in 0 30'. Both V(a_in) and V(b_in) must be at least 11.6V. Return {"placements": [...min-corner [x,y,z] per component...], "netlist": "..."}. Wire resistance is 0.004 ohm per mm of Manhattan (axis-aligned) distance between component centers; the grader computes it from your placements and inserts it between the named nodes itself. Do NOT connect those node pairs directly in your netlist.
